title: 65% of direct bookings start on an OTA.
styleLine: ONE CONSISTENT LINE ACROSS ALL IMAGES (critical). Cinematic editorial photography, shot as if by the SAME photographer on the SAME 35mm lens, same warm natural grade — deep navy shadows (#262B38) + warm cream light (#F7F8EA), rich but natural (NOT a heavy Instagram filter, NOT washed-out, NOT HDR). Modern boutique-hotel world: walnut wood, cream plaster, greenery, contemporary fixtures. NO dated props (no key racks, service bells, fountain pens, paper ledgers, cash). Elegant, quiet, expensive. 4:5 aspect (1080x1350), designed for Instagram feed carousels (full frame visible) and TikTok photo carousels. SAFE ZONES: (a) Instagram profile grid crops to CENTER 1:1 — the top ~135px and bottom ~135px are cropped in the grid view, so keep the hero subject center-frame. (b) TikTok photo mode overlays a caption/UI region across the bottom ~340px on the visible feed — keep any critical visual detail above that band. (c) The lower ~40% of the frame (roughly y=810 to y=1350 on a 1080x1350 canvas) is reserved for on-slide type — subject sits in the upper ~55-60% with a naturally darker, less busy lower area. No text, no logos, no clearly identifiable faces.
note: Path B. No device composite in this one — all six slides are pure photos.

slides.characterDef: CHARACTER: a man in his late 30s, warm medium skin tone, short dark hair, wearing a relaxed navy linen shirt with sleeves rolled to mid-forearm. No watch, no rings, no visible tattoos. This character appears in slides 1, 2, and 5 — every detail must match.
slides.imagePrompt: A relaxed man in his late 30s (warm medium skin, short dark hair, navy linen shirt with sleeves rolled to mid-forearm) seated at a warm cafe table by a window. He holds an iPhone FACING THE CAMERA STRAIGHT-ON — screen perfectly flat, parallel to the lens, completely blank pure white, no tilt or angle. A cup of coffee and a small plant beside him. Warm daylight. His face is soft, not the focus — shoot from chest level, slightly off-axis so the phone is the hero. Boutique cafe aesthetic. The subject must sit in the UPPER ~55-60% of the frame, leaving a clean, uncluttered, darker LOWER ~40% for text. CRITICAL: any darker area must be darker ONLY because the scene's own light falls off naturally — NOT because a dark band, gradient, vignette or overlay has been applied. There must be NO horizontal boundary, step, line or abrupt change of tone anywhere in the frame; brightness must fall away gradually and continuously. [Apply the STYLE LINE.]
